hypothesis: A blind LLM reading of each sample's PIT METAR sequence and forecast path can identify physical support, counterevidence, and omitted mechanisms that are materially inconsistent with the production Core v3 feature-contribution direction.
denominator: The same 63 pre-label policy-contrast checkpoints: all 28 policy-selected v3 checkpoints, 7 earlier same-city-day non-positive-EV checkpoints, and 28 never-selected matched controls. Every underlying Core-scored row remains in the quantitative ledger.
information_order: LLM receives only PIT weather observations, report/first-seen clocks, forecast curve and deterministic physical state
production model logit contributions, market probability, policy role and settlement are attached afterward
human/structured audit classifies aligned, ambiguous, omitted or materially conflicting semantics
production_model: current_yes_core_carry_model_v3_no_peak_clock; market_logit + local hour + dewpoint depression + wind speed
primary_output: Per-sample dossier with raw METAR sequence, LLM physical read, exact model feature contributions, omitted-present signals, settlement and a semantic alignment judgment.
analysis_boundary: Retrospective mechanism audit only. No probability-head fitting, performance promotion, gate, veto or live action.
